question: What is the speaker committing to disclose to the beloved one?
premises: The speaker addresses the beloved one.
An arrangement of rows of yoginīs is the object.
The speaker commits to telling it.
inference: The speaker shall tell the beloved one about the arrangement of rows of yoginīs.
uncertainties: The details of that arrangement are not given in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved one, I shall tell you the arrangement of rows of yoginīs.
